data.description:
## Incident Overview

CI Script Tests job on PR #36 fails 2 of 4 assertions in test-sprint-continuation-guidance.sh because the test extracts content using \`### Step 10:\`/\`### Step 11:\` awk patterns, but PR #36 renumbered Phase F so Step 10 is now Step 17 (Commit & Push) and Step 11 is Step 19 (Context Compaction Check). Step 10a is now Step 18 (Close Completed Tasks).

## Reproducer

\`\`\`
\$ bash tests/scripts/test-sprint-continuation-guidance.sh
FAIL: test_continue_callout_exists: CONTINUE callout in Step 10
FAIL: test_step_10a_exists: Step 10a heading between Step 10 and Step 11
PASSED: 2  FAILED: 2
\`\`\`

## Expected vs Observed

**Expected:** Test asserts a CONTINUE callout in the Commit & Push section and a Close-Completed-Tasks heading immediately after.

**Observed:** Awk patterns reference legacy step numbers (Step 10, 10a, 11). The CONTINUE callout and the Close-Completed-Tasks heading still exist in SKILL.md but at Steps 17 and 18 respectively.

## Bug Scope

Update awk extraction patterns in test-sprint-continuation-guidance.sh from \`### Step 10\`, \`### Step 10a\`, \`### Step 11\` to the new step labels (\`### Step 17\`, \`### Step 18\`, \`### Step 19\`). Update header docstring and assertion error messages to match.
data.title: [Script Tests CI]: test-sprint-continuation-guidance.sh -> 2 stale Step 10/10a/11 references after Phase F renumbering
